text:
Morgan: PSA: multiple customers reporting 502s and timeouts on /v1/generate in ap-southeast-1 starting ~22:12 UTC. Seeing spikes in p95 latency and client timeouts. CC @Sasha @Devon :rotating_light:
Sasha: On it — grabbing gateway traces and envoy logs. Any deploys or config changes in the window?
Devon: No code deploys. We did a batcher tuning at 21:40 — reduced max_batch_size to 8 and increased max_wait_ms to 60 to optimize small-request latency.
Priya: Observing GPU queue depth climb and pending requests piling on dedicated-pool-12. p95 inference time up ~2.3x for the impacted tenants.
Liam: Envoy shows a lot of "upstream prematurely closed connection" and 502s followed by client-side 30s timeouts.
OpsBot: Incident war-room created: <https://redwood.warroom/1748102468> — use channel for updates.
Morgan: Quick mitigation plan: rollback the batcher tuning and enable fallback routing to legacy dedicated pool for 10% of traffic. Can someone do the rollback?
Devon: Rolling batcher config back now (22:35 UTC). Will monitor.
Devon: Rolled back at 22:35 UTC. Switching 10% traffic to dedicated-pool-legacy (canary) at 22:40.
Sasha: After rollback + canary, 502 rate dropped ~70% within 10m. Still watching for residual errors.
CS_Anya: Customer comms: notifying impacted customers with interim status, what we rolled back, and ETA for RCA.
Priya: Hypothesis: the new batcher parameters increased variance for requests with mixed seq-len, causing head-of-line blocking in the GPU queue -> backend timeouts -> envoy 502s. Also saw a KV-cache miss spike correlated with the rollout.
Liam: KV-cache miss spike looks like warmup/eviction behavior interacting with routing changes. Need to check cache TTLs and warmup on routing shifts.
Morgan: Action items (owners + due dates):
- Devon: Re-run offline workload sim using 10k+ real requests and seq-len distribution to reproduce (due 2024-03-28).
- Priya: Add alert for GPU queue depth >80% sustained for 5m and dashboarded runbook links (due 2024-03-25).
- Sasha: Introduce a runtime gate for batcher changes with automated canary threshold + rollback (owner Sasha, due 2024-04-01).
- Priya & Devon: Investigate KV-cache warmup strategy and add proactive warming during reroutes/rollouts (due 2024-03-30).
- CS_Anya: Draft customer email summarizing incident, mitigation, and next steps (due 2024-03-24).
Sasha: Temporary follow-up: pinning batcher to previous config for 48h and observing. If stable, schedule controlled rollout with traffic shaping.
Liam: I'll schedule a 60m RCA meeting for 2024-03-26 and invite infra/runtime/CS/eng-oncall.
Morgan: Thanks everyone. We'll keep this war-room open until 48h of stability. If no regressions, close and postmortem. :white_check_mark:
OpsBot: War-room closed at 00:12 UTC after stabilization and no elevation. Incident INC-1748102468 created for tracking and postmortem follow-up.
